reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for managing global and workspace rules, injecting them into system prompts, and exposing them through an HTTP API and rules_read model tool.

summaries.zh: 用于管理全局与工作区规则，并将生效规则注入系统提示词供模型读取的 DeepSeek Harness 插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for managing global and workspace rules, injecting active rules into system prompts, and making them available through a model tool.

capabilities: Stores global and workspace rules in configurable paths
Injects stored rules into the system prompt
Provides an HTTP JSON API to list, save, delete, import, and configure rules
Provides a rules_read model tool to read active rules
